page.notes: Greek and Hebrew readings are uncertain at several points and are marked [?]. The Hebrew word beside "vel" is only approximated; the Greek after "ἀλλαγή" and the Greek of the first and fourth paragraphs need checking against the scan. The last line ends mid-word ("interru") at the page foot and continues on the next page; it is left as printed without a hyphen. The dot in the left margin beside "vel" is a stray mark, not a note.
